summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandmother; mother of Maria Antonia DiBiasi.
bio: Tree: Rosa Siconolfi (b. 1840). FS tree: b. 1839, 'born Lucera, Foggia' (unsourced; treated as an error). Siconolfi is Guardia Lombardi's most common surname: paese.app shows Guardia as the #1 comune (14 US arrivals 1830-1912); a modern Guardia phone directory lists Siconolfi 21 times; Guardia has a frazione called Case Siconolfi; the current/recent sindaco of Guardia is a Siconolfi (surname only, no kinship). Note: if born 1839, she was about 17 at son Domenico Antonio's birth in 1856. FS profile lists children born 1891 and 1894 (age 52-55) - mis-attachments.
